## Charming Assassin (CR 7)

**XP** 3,200  
 Female elf bard 5/assassin 3  
 NE Medium humanoid (elf)  
 **Init** +3; **Senses** low-light vision; Perception +15  

**Defense**

 **AC** 18, touch 13, flat-footed 15 (+5 armor, +3 Dex)  
 **hp** 56 (8d8–8)  
 **Fort** +2, **Ref** +10, **Will** +8; +1 vs. poison; +2 vs. enchantments; +4 vs. bardic performance, language-dependent, and sonic  
 **Defensive Abilities** uncanny dodge; **Immune** sleep  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft.  
 **Melee** violin bow (improvised) +7 (1d3–1) or +1 dagger +8 (1d4+4/19–20 plus poison)  
 **Ranged** dagger +7 (1d4–1/19–20 plus Poison)  
 **Special Attacks** bardic performance 15 rounds/day (countersong, distraction, fascinate [DC 16], inspire competence +2, inspire courage +2), death attack (DC 15), sneak attack +2d6  
 **Spells Known** (CL 5th; concentration +8)  

   2nd (3/day)—
  *[eagle’s splendor](../../magic/spells/eagles-splendor.md)*,
  *[hold person](../../magic/spells/hold-person.md)* (DC 15),
  *[silence](../../magic/spells/silence.md)* (DC 15)
  
 1st (5/day)—
  *[disguise self](../../magic/spells/disguise-self.md)*,
  *[expeditious retreat](../../magic/spells/expeditious-retreat.md)*,
  *[sleep](../../magic/spells/sleep.md)* (DC 15),
  *[undetectable alignment](../../magic/spells/undetectable-alignment.md)*
  
 0 (at will)—
  *[detect magic](../../magic/spells/detect-magic.md)*,
  *[lullaby](../../magic/spells/lullaby.md)* (DC 14),
  *[mage hand](../../magic/spells/mage-hand.md)*,
  *[open/close](../../magic/spells/open-close.md)*,
  *[prestidigitation](../../magic/spells/prestidigitation.md)*,
  *[read magic](../../magic/spells/read-magic.md)*
  
 **Tactics**  
 **Before Combat** She avoids actual combat if at all possible, fleeing confrontations that do not happen on her terms. When she is about to commit murder, she casts *eagle’s splendor*, poisons her daggers, uses fascinate, and finishes with a death attack.  
 **During Combat** She uses *hold person*, *sleep*, or her catch off-Guard feat to make sneak attacks. She uses *silence* to prevent her foes from calling for aid, and Bluff and Diplomacy skills if guards respond to the noise.  
 **Morale** If she is outnumbered or a victim does not succumb to her bardic abilities, she flees immediately.  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 8, **Dex** 16, **Con** 8, **Int** 14, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 16  
 **Base Atk** +4; **CMB** +7; **CMD** 16  
 **Feats** [Throw Anything](../../rules/feats/throw-anything.md), Quick Draw, Run, [Weapon Finesse](../../rules/feats/weapon-finesse.md)  
*House rules: Catch Off-Guard is part of Throw Anything; Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  
 **Skills** Disguise +11, Intimidate +11, Knowledge (Local) +12, Perception +15, Perform (act) +14, Perform (string instruments) +14,, Sense Motive +13, Sleight of Hand +14, Stealth +14  
 **Languages** Celestial, Common, Elven, Sylvan  
 **SQ** bardic knowledge +2, elven magic, lore master (1/day), Poison use, versatile performance (string instruments), weapon familiarity  
 **Combat Gear** *potion of cure moderate wounds*, *potions of invisibility* (2); **Other Gear** *+1 mithral chain shirt*, *+1 dagger*, daggers (2), *cloak of resistance +1*, jewelry (worth 300 gp), large scorpion venom (5), masterwork violin, 350 gp
